evidence_sentence: It checks the lengths of these names against predefined maximums to prevent buffer overflows.
rationale: The vulnerable implementation reads the class and attribute lengths and immediately uses them for memcpy and terminator indexing without bounds checks. The fixed implementation uniquely adds assertions requiring each length to be less than its corresponding maximum before copying. The docstring explicitly describes those fixed-only checks and their overflow-prevention purpose.
rewritten_docstring: The function begins by validating the input parameters and extracting the class name and attribute name from the socket buffer. It processes the names for lookup against the available objects and attributes. If the specified object or attribute is not found, it sends a response indicating the error. If both are found, it retrieves the attribute value and sends a successful response with the value. Debugging information is logged throughout the process to assist in tracing execution and errors.
